name: Primal Manifestations (Legendary Hunter Archetype)
body:
Primal manifestations are made up of the following:

Appearance changes, which are suggestions for the hunter to spice up the description of their companion; a Subtype; and a 7th-level growth option.

Plant type or is plant-like with an Intelligence of 2 or lower willingly attacks the plant master or their companion unless magically compelled to or if the plant master or companion attacks it first.

The plant master and their companion can attempt to demoralize creatures in the appropriate category as a swift action, rolling 1d20 and adding the plant master’s level and their Charisma modifier to determine the Intimidate check result. This ability works even if they are normally immune to the effect.

This ability replaces one with the wild.
